title: Vibrant Peppery Ethiopian Chicken Kik Alicha
description: A spicy and flavorful Ethiopian dish featuring chicken cooked in a vibrant peppery sauce, perfect for a sick day pick-me-up. This recipe incorporates ssamjang for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together ssamjang, berbere spice, black pepper, and salt.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the chicken, cooking until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce over a slate tile or other heat-resistant surface.
Dehydrate any excess sauce in the oven at 200 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes to thicken.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
